Header: Sphaerotheca pannosa Sinhala –“Piti pus”; Tamil- Thool poonchanam

Prevention: Maintain proper spacing (20 x 20 cm) between plants
Avoid overhead irrigation especially in humid conditions
Do not cultivate in shaded areas
Do not hard prune roses during the rainy season
Use fungicides (see yellow direct control) as a preventive measure during humid weather conditions
Monitoring: Look for the following symptoms – red blister like areas in the upper leaf surface
Later these areas show white powder like growth
Direct Control: Collect and burn infected and fallen leaves
Rate of dilution- 10 g/10 lit .of water.
Rate of dilution – 10 ml/10 lit. of water.
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read the manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, smoke or drink while spraying pesticides.
Do not repeat pesticides with same mode of action
U – Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use
FRAC – Fungicide resistant action committee -Mode of action
Moderately harmful to predatory mites and flower bugs
Rate of dilution- 30 ml / 10 lit. of water.
Toxic to predatory mites, fish and earthworms
Toxic to fish and moderately toxic to predatory mites and parasitoids
